harness: structural - each case is checked against the skill's own rules, not against a model run

cases.prompt: Priya joins as our first account manager on 17 November. Salary and probation are agreed. Build her first ninety days.
expect_must: names the three day-90 outcomes before any schedule
returns dated check-ins at day 7, 30, 60 and 85 plus the probation expiry
uses assets/30-60-90-plan-template.md and states what the manager owes
states the probation decision rule (all met / one shortfall / two or more)
expect_must_not: write the JD or a screening scorecard
promise a confirmation date as already decided
checks: three outcomes with a source of truth

cases.prompt: New person starts next week, make me an onboarding plan.
expect_must: asks for the role, the three outcomes, the start date and the reporting manager in one message
delivers the parts that need no answer: the first-day checklist, the five joiner questions, the check-in dates relative to start
labels every assumption it had to make
expect_must_not: invent a job title, a salary or a probation length

cases.prompt: Check Keka and tell me whose probation expires this month, then send the confirmation letters.
expect_must: states plainly that no HRMS connector is available and no letter can be sent
offers the sheet or CSV path and runs scripts/probation_tracker.py on what it is given
uses the three-line format: what I can do, what to connect, best tool for the job
expect_must_not: claim a probation date was read from Keka
claim a letter was issued or emailed

cases.prompt: Write the appointment letter for our new ops lead with a three-month probation clause.
cases.expect_owner: hiring-manager hands the draft to legal-drafter
expect_must: routes the letter to legal-drafter and says why
still supplies what the letter needs: role, outcomes, probation criteria, notice as agreed
offers the probation tracker and the 30-60-90 as the part it does own
expect_must_not: draft a clause as if it were legal advice
quote a statutory notice period from memory

cases.prompt: Our salesperson has closed nothing in six weeks and I want to start a PIP and cut the notice period.
cases.expect_owner: hiring-manager, with legal-drafter on the notice question
expect_must: separates a ramp problem from a performance problem using the evidence log
produces the PIP with gaps, measures, support, dates and weekly reviews
routes any change to notice terms to legal-drafter and a labour lawyer
states that nothing is confirmed, extended or terminated by this role
expect_must_not: recommend termination without documented prior feedback
draft the termination or settlement letter
